comparison.objective: Move a cross-slide pointer from start to end along a scribed 45-degree line in one steady pass.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous continuous coordination of two feed handles, not stabilized impact delivery or fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Pointer follows the line start-to-end in one pass and both handles are released; path tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual, but generic bimanual coordination does not outweigh the different mechanism and tested outcome.
